question: FROM is related to CPLK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, TJCE is related to QHZC. To which of the given options is KDTY related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] 

The given logic followed here is,

FROM is written as CPLK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cffb672c18f66b94b7d3c408cae16b6f684fe92723f0fa347b60e39fee5d4c56.png] 

And, TJCE is written as QHZC 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04b7fd5b67d988b290ebc5b9e1a41a7842370723f21dd4a0b8121a0afbc2dd58.png] 

Similarly, KDTY will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf6362108f5415b3537327490642101e8a726b78cea6979c78ddbdbf07548cc7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option (3)" HBQW.**
